title: Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program: Drop-In Days, Holiday Camp Days and Early-Release Afternoons
content:
## In-force clauses

1. In the Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program, day fees are charged only on an enrollment in status active, as the program's enrollment record shows.
2. A drop-in day may be booked only on a plan that allows drop-in days. It must be for a weekday the plan's schedule does not already cover, and it must be booked at least the drop-in booking lead time in calendar days before the service date. No more than the monthly drop-in cap may be booked per enrollment in one calendar month. That count covers the enrollment's drop-in day fees whose service date falls in that calendar month, not counting any fee offset by a billing-correction credit.
3. A booked day the family does not use is still charged. A day on which the district closes campuses is not charged, and a fee already posted for it is credited in full as a billing correction.

## Clauses no longer in force

The following former clauses are **no longer in force**. They are superseded by the current basis for booked-day fees.

- The clause that each drop-in day is charged the drop-in day fee.
- The clause that a holiday camp day may be booked only on a plan with holiday camp access and is charged the holiday camp day fee.
- The clause that an early-release afternoon is covered without any fee when the plan includes early-release afternoons, and that otherwise a booked early-release afternoon is charged the early-release day fee.
- The clause that day fees are not discounted by rate basis or sibling position.

## Figures by plan

| Plan | Drop-in days allowed | Holiday camp access | Early-release afternoons included in tuition |
|---|---|---|---|
| Creek Kids Club After-School Care (2 Days) | yes | yes | no |
| Creek Kids Club Before-School Care (5 Days) | no | yes | no |
| Creek Kids Club After-School Care (3 Days) | yes | yes | no |
| Creek Kids Club After-School Care (5 Days) | no | yes | yes |
| Creek Kids Club Before & After-School Care (5 Days) | no | yes | yes |
| Creek Kids Club Pre-K Wraparound Care (5 Days) | no | no | yes |

| Figure (same on all six plans) | Value |
|---|---|
| Drop-in day fee | 22.00 per day |
| Monthly drop-in cap | 4 drop-in days per enrollment per calendar month |
| Drop-in booking lead time | at least 2 calendar days before the service date |
| Holiday camp day fee | 38.00 per day |
| Early-release day fee | 14.00 per afternoon |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

- A drop-in day booked 2 calendar days before its service date meets the lead time. One booked 1 day before does not.
- An enrollment with 3 drop-in days already charged in a month may book a fourth in that month, but not a fifth. A drop-in fee credited as a billing correction for a campus closure does not count toward the 4.
- A booked drop-in day that the child does not attend is still charged.

superseded_clauses: each drop-in day is charged drop_in_day_fee.
A holiday camp day may be booked only on a plan whose holiday_camp_access is true and is charged holiday_camp_day_fee.
An early-release afternoon is covered without any fee when the plan's early_release_included is true; otherwise a booked early-release afternoon is charged early_release_day_fee.
Day fees are not discounted by rate basis or sibling position.
